# <Experience> — manual verification

Automated checks stay at the unit, integration, and end-to-end tiers. Manual verification is their product-experience counterpart: it records whether the experience is right for a real person, which no test asserts.

## Target

Who was observed and what they were trying to do, without coaching.

## Task

The concrete task the target attempted.

## Observation

What happened, in the target's words where possible. Record friction, confusion, and abandonment, not only success.

## Decision

What the observation changes: keep, adjust, or drop, and which automated check will carry the lesson forward.
